summary: The Source Data Import Settings window is resizable, opens larger, and its table list can be searched.
details: The window now opens at 800px wide with the SQL Server fields in two columns, and can be resized by dragging its bottom-right corner.
The Table Or View list has a search box that filters as you type, shows how many of the total match, and picks a unique match on Enter.
Dropdown arrows now render as a proper filled triangle that flips while the list is open, instead of a flat bar.
